$comment: Provenance manifest for the Lexora corpus. Every document is an OFFICIAL English
publication of a UAE federal ministry or the Government of Dubai.
`official_url` is the canonical government URL. `mirror_url`, when present, is a
Wayback Machine snapshot OF THAT EXACT FILE, used only when the official host is
unreachable from the build network (see corpus/README.md 'Fallback note').
`sha256` pins the bytes. corpus/download.py refuses to install a file whose digest
does not match, so a silently-changed or man-in-the-middled document cannot enter
`label` is what the UI prints inside a citation chip, e.g. [Labour Law - Art. 51].

documents.label: Labour Law
documents.title: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships (as amended), with Cabinet Resolution No. 1 of 2022
documents.publisher: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE)
documents.notes: Consolidated English text: 74 articles of the Decree-Law plus the executive regulations issued as Cabinet Resolution No. 1 of 2022.

documents.label: Tenancy Law
documents.title: Law No. 26 of 2007 Regulating the Relationship between Landlords and Tenants in the Emirate of Dubai
documents.publisher: Government of Dubai — Legal Affairs Department
documents.notes: Base tenancy statute. Several articles are superseded by Law No. 33 of 2008.

documents.label: Tenancy Amendment
documents.title: Law No. 33 of 2008 Amending Law No. 26 of 2007 Regulating the Relationship between Landlords and Tenants in the Emirate of Dubai
documents.publisher: Government of Dubai — Legal Affairs Department
documents.notes: Replaces and adds articles in Law 26/2007. Article numbers intentionally collide with the base law — retrieval must keep the two laws distinguishable, which is exactly what the law_id payload filter is for.

documents.label: Rent Decree
documents.title: Decree No. 43 of 2013 Determining Rent Increase for Real Property in the Emirate of Dubai
documents.publisher: Government of Dubai — Legal Affairs Department
documents.notes: The rent-cap ladder every Dubai tenant asks about. Short, numeric, and a good exact-term retrieval probe.
